title: CA125 Levels and Other Inflammatory Markers in Laparoscopic Ventral Hernia Repair
brief_summary: The study aims to show variation in CA-125 and other inflammatory markers assumed to be a response to trauma and peritoneal inflammation in the perioperative period of laparoscopic ventral hernia repair
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults admitted for ventral or incisional hernia repair

Exclusion Criteria:

* Loss-of-domain
* ASA above III
* Liver failure
* Abnormal CA-125 prior to surgery
